summary: Centrus Energy Corp. filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting a September 9 underwriting agreement with Guggenheim Securities as representative of the underwriters. The offering comprises 500,000 Class A common shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 2,005,513 shares at $0.10 per share, and common warrants for up to 6,992,382 shares across four tranches with exercise prices from $226.8625 to $362.98. Warrants carry a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker, adjustable to 9.99%. The filing reflects a capital-raising event with dilutive warrant overhang, not a change of control. Watch for warrant exercises and stock performance relative to tranche thresholds.
